name: gmkit-monorepo
description: GMKit polyglot monorepo for Java and TypeScript packages

scripts.verify: npm run test:ts && npm run test:java && npm run parity && npm run build:ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run type-check -w packages/ts && npm test -w packages/ts
scripts.parity: mvn -f packages/java/pom.xml -B -ntp -pl gmkit -Dtest=InteropComplianceTest test && npx vitest run test/interop-compliance.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --root packages/ts
